arms.RGB6_on_S2: the v0.22.0 RGB6 certifier run unchanged on top of S2 regions (noise eps 0.02 only)
arms.S1: frozen exact search: brute.region RegionSpace via bigstate.big(), family cap raised to n_max = 16 by the same wrapper pattern (no frozen file edited)
arms.S2: new exact search (new file brute/scalesearch.py): (i) incremental SAT with assumptions, one solver kept across steps (clauses only added); (ii) BFS-canonical symmetry breaking (first-visit order + lexicographic successor tables); (iii) iterative state-count deepening n = 1..n_max, stopping at the least n with a model; (iv) a passive state-merging witness (RPNI-style) used only as a solver phase hint, never as a result. Answers must equal S1's wherever S1 finishes

motivation: Every study through 025 runs on worlds of at most 4 hidden states (cycle3, switch3, unaliased2, ood4) with learner families capped at 5 (big() at 8). v0.23.0 asks whether the exact certified region learner scales to 8-16 state worlds when the exact search is made smarter, without giving up 0 false certificates.
